mapper.select: select * from t_post order by create_time desc
mapper.insert: insert into t_post (user_id, title, content, images, categories, location, visibility, create_time, update_time, like_count, collect_count, browse_count) values (#{userId}, #{title}, #{content}, #{images}, #{categories}, #{location}, #{visibility}, now(), now(), 0, 0, 0)
mapper.update: update t_post set title = #{title}, content = #{content}, images = #{images}, categories = #{categories}, location = #{location}, visibility = #{visibility}, update_time = now(), like_count = #{likeCount}, collect_count = #{collectCount}, browse_count = #{browseCount} where id = #{id}
update t_post set browse_count = browse_count + 1 where id = #{id}
mapper.select:
select * from t_post
and title like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%')
and JSON_CONTAINS(categories, CONCAT('"', #{category}, '"'))
order by create_time desc
select * from t_post where user_id = #{userId} order by create_time desc
select p.* from t_post p inner join t_collect c on p.id = c.post_id where c.user_id = #{userId} order by c.create_time desc
select p.* from t_post p inner join t_like l on p.id = l.post_id where l.user_id = #{userId} and l.type = 1 order by l.create_time desc
select count(*) from t_post where user_id = #{userId}
select count(*) from t_post where user_id = #{userId}

select p.* from t_post p left join (select post_id, count(*) as comment_count from t_comment group by post_id) c on p.id = c.post_id where p.title like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or p.content like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or JSON_CONTAINS(p.categories, CONCAT('"', #{keyword}, '"')) order by COALESCE(c.comment_count, 0) desc, p.create_time desc

select p.categories, COALESCE(c.comment_count, 0) as comment_count from t_post p left join (select post_id, count(*) as comment_count from t_comment group by post_id) c on p.id = c.post_id where p.categories != '[]'

select distinct p.* from t_post p
and p.title like concat('%', #{condition.keyword}, '%')
and JSON_CONTAINS(p.categories, CONCAT('"', #{condition.category}, '"'))
and ( p.visibility = 1 or (p.visibility = 2 and p.user_id = #{condition.currentUserId}) or (p.visibility = 2 and exists ( select 1 from t_friend f where (f.user_id = #{condition.currentUserId} and f.friend_id = p.user_id) or (f.user_id = p.user_id and f.friend_id = #{condition.currentUserId}) and f.status = 1 )) or (p.visibility = 3 and p.user_id = #{condition.currentUserId}) )
order by p.create_time desc
